run_puts_json_cli: run the puts_json CLI to generate per-audiofile JSON metadata alongside LibriLight FLAC files
normalize_book_name: normalize a LibriVox book directory name by stripping ffmpeg suffixes like _librivox or _64kb
parse_downloaded_jsons: parse LibriVox metadata and speaker JSON files from a directory into a normalized name-to-data mapping
read_snr_tsv: read a tab-separated SNR file and build a nested dictionary mapping normalized book names to file SNR values
process_dir_per_book: process a single book directory to create per-file JSON with speaker, SNR, voice activity, and book metadata
